title: Bihar Police CSBC Constable Final Result 2026
intro: Short Information : Central Selection Board of Constable (CSBC) has released the final result for the post of Constable. This recruitment was released for 19,838 posts. Applications for the Bihar Police CSBC Constable Recruitment 2025 were accepted from March 18, 2025, to April 25, 2025. The PET examination was held on 15 December 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Bihar Police CSBC Constable Final Result 2026 from the link given below.
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
